auto_turbo.note: Optional ON/OFF toggle (default OFF). Triggers 230G at Equity >= 1.25x ($12,500), disengages < 1.15x ($11,500), enforces hard worst-case SL floor >= 1.10x ($11,000).

pause_resume_policy.note: Rule 4E: Only Core trades (vol > 0.45x) count toward 2-SL Portfolio Shadow-Win pause; auto-resume after 1 shadow win (or 72h max).

summary.winrate_methodology: 1U = U3_HTF_MACRO_ATR (Close * max(0.0008, EMA20_4H(0.5*ATR14_4H/Close_4H) * gamma_tf)), evaluated across 36M (11/2023->10/2026) with pf_is = Train 2Y (11/2023->10/2025) & pf_oos = Blind Y3 (11/2025->10/2026). Profit-Weighted WR = GP / (GP + GL) * 100.
